item.title: More tuberculosis exposures reported at Southwest High School
item.description: The County of San Diego has notified students and staff at Southwest High School that they may have been exposed to tuberculosis.

item.title: The Black is back: Classic Ocean Beach smoke shop to reopen
item.description: The Black, a cultural hub in Ocean Beach, will be reopening soon after new owners purchased the iconic San Diego business.

item.title: Matt Mahan addresses TJ River sewage crisis, campaign for governor
item.description: Matt Mahan, a California governor candidate, visited the Tijuana River sewage crisis and vowed to declare a state of emergency if elected, while San Diego County Supervisor Paloma Aguirre urged gubernatorial candidates to take state action.

item.title: 5 takeaways from Trump’s Iran presser at Doral
item.description: President Trump suggested the war with Iran could be coming to a close during a press conference at his Miami resort on Monday, which immediately followed his address to House Republicans at their annual retreat. “Very soon,” Trump said when asked when the war would end. “Look, everything they have is gone, including their leadership.” [...]

item.title: 44 detox beds for homeless population open in San Diego
item.description: County leaders and Father Joe's Villages have opened up 44 new detox beds for people experiencing homelessness in San Diego.

item.title: El Cajon police investigate crash injuring two juveniles
item.description: Two juveniles were reportedly injured in a two-vehicle crash in El Cajon on Sunday.

item.title: San Diego crime rates declined fourth year in a row, according to SDPD
item.description: San Diego's overall crime rate has dropped for the fourth consecutive year, according to a report from the San Diego Police Department.

item.title: E-bike related traumas surge, Rady Children's Hospital warns
item.description: E-bikes have become increasingly popular in San Diego, and a new Rady Children's Hospital study shows a resulting rise in injuries and trauma cases.

item.title: Chaldean Catholic bishop accused of embezzlement pleads not guilty at first court hearing
item.description: Bishop Emmanuel Shaleta, who leads Chaldean Catholics in the western United States, pleaded not guilty at his arraignment on Monday after being arrested at San Diego International Airport for allegedly embezzling church funds and money laundering.
